EXTRUSION TECHNOLOGY

MEL

MUCELL EXTRUSION Polymer reduction technology

+ Read more page 9

Innovative and accessible technology for greener, lower-cost plastic products This pioneering technology injects gas into plastics during the manufacturing process to create micro-bubbles and is licensed to customers manufacturing plastic parts. The end-product uses 15-20% less material. Recently developed ReLorce recyclable mono-material barrier packaging solutions use this technology.
